ECE 685 | Per Unit II 15/38

Transformer normalization: summary
With compatible bases, normalization removes the ideal turns
ratio from the per-unit circuit, connects the primary and
secondary internal ports at the same per-unit voltage , and
allows circuits at different physical voltage levels to form one
per-unit network.
ECE 685 | Per Unit II 16/38
